scope: Independent source/evidence review; no full game startup or phone scene has been run in this task.

graphics_root_cause.verified_source: Pinned Metal HAL advertises 60 varying components / 4 = 15 variables on this iOS path; pinned wgpu-core checks vertex output locations against 0..14.
graphics_root_cause.extra_output: Location 15 mirrors the four clip-distance values. The builtin clip-distance array is separate and remains intact.
graphics_root_cause.fix: Move location 15 to free location 7 for this pair. Common linker remaps matching fragment inputs when consumed, retaining all values/types/qualifiers/builtins.

runtime_issues.decision: No metadata rewrite or fictitious class. Potential scenario/spawning impact; no evidence this caused the current Prologue GPU stop.
